# OpenBible language data

`afr.js` and `ben.js` are unmodified MIT-licensed generated language data from
[OpenBible Bible-Passage-Reference-Parser-Languages](https://github.com/openbibleinfo/Bible-Passage-Reference-Parser-Languages/tree/5735787d970a87483eac580e5c1d1b5192c3ed48/lang),
commit `5735787d970a87483eac580e5c1d1b5192c3ed48`, retrieved 2026-09-30.
The upstream data is human-sourced; the upstream project states most generation
code is AI-generated. Our all-locale fixtures test this pinned output.

The common parser and other 19 languages use npm `bible-passage-reference-parser`
4.0.0, integrity-pinned in package-lock.json. All parser code is build-only.
